name: select.tn
title: select
source:
# `select` waits on several channels at once and takes the first ready arm.
# The canonical use is a timeout: race real work against a fiber that sleeps then signals.

fn worker(result: Chan[Int]) -> Unit:
    sleep(10)             # pretend this is real work
    send(result, 42)

fn timeout(fired: Chan[Bool]) -> Unit:
    sleep(50)             # deadline: 50ms
    send(fired, true)

fn main() -> Unit:
    let result = chan[Int]()
    let fired = chan[Bool]()
    spawn worker(result)
    spawn timeout(fired)

    # the worker (10ms) beats the timeout (50ms), so the first arm wins
    select:
        v = recv(result) =>
            match v:
                Some(n) => print(n)
                None => print("worker channel closed")
        deadline = recv(fired) =>
            print("timed out")

name: shapes.tn
title: shapes
source:
enum Shape:
    Circle(Float)
    Rect(Float, Float)

fn area(s: Shape) -> Float:
    match s:
        Circle(r) => 3.14159 * r * r
        Rect(w, h) => w * h

fn main() -> Unit:
    print(area(Circle(2.0)))
    print(area(Rect(3.0, 4.0)))
